control_plane_items.detail: opencode/beam-free answers the health tool_probe with PASS but rejects the real agent request with [unsupported_parameter] Unrecognized request argument supplied: permissions, so a healthy-looking pool slot can still kill the lane before the agent starts. The probe must reproduce the agent request shape; model_health.json is workflow-owned and is recorded, never edited, from this lane.

No workflow step installs product/requirements-query.txt before the agent starts, so a fresh runner begins with no numpy and no scikit-learn. The lane now self-heals from product/tests/conftest.py via product.query_env.ensure(); the missing workflow step remains recorded, never edited, from here.

meaning: Observed evidence from committed job logs of three failed product runs. The two failure classes are control-plane/model-pool and fresh-runner-validation facts, not product verdicts: no gate is written, no run is labelled accepted or rejected, and no frozen bar, rubric or threshold is touched.
